messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INC-3127 opened — Console degradation (staging + prod canary)
Symptoms: Console cost breakdown page loading slowly / timing out for some tenants.
Suspected dependency: cost-model-service (SCM) endpoint timeouts.

Sean Gallagher: Taking IC. Assigning Rafael as Ops + Chloe as Console liaison. Neha on infra. :pager:

Rafael Mendes: Looking at Grafana now. Seeing cost-model-service p99 spike + 5xx/timeout rate jump starting ~10 min ago. Correlates with canary enablement.
Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/scm-service/scm-service-overview (internal)

Chloe Martin: Confirmed from Console logs in staging + canary tenant in prod: requests to `/cost-model/v1/estimate` hitting client timeout (currently 2.5s). Console endpoint then blocks page render.
Sample log:
`CostModelClient timeout after 2500ms tenant=ten_9d2 route=/console/costs/breakdown`

Dylan Brooks: UI impact: cost breakdown table shows spinner then “Something went wrong” for those tenants. Rest of Console mostly ok but costs page degraded.
We have fallback to “no breakdown” but it’s behind the `scm_cost_breakdown_enabled` flag.

Neha Kapoor: cost-model-service pods look healthy-ish but CPU is pegged on 2 pods in us-east-1 canary pool. Autoscaler lagging.
I can bump min replicas + increase CPU limit. Also checking if there’s a hot shard on tenant id.

Logan Wright: Telemetry pipeline looks fine; no ingestion lag. But I see a huge increase in distinct `model_variant` tag values in scm request logs (cardinality explosion?) since the new canary build.

Jordan Lee: That smells like version negotiation / fallback path doing extra catalog lookups per request. If the model catalog call is slow we’ll cascade.
Any recent deploy?

Benji Okafor: We rolled out `cost-model-service` build `2025.02.13.3` to staging + 5% prod canary ~25 mins ago behind `scm_service_canary_v1`. Feature flag for Console breakdown enabled for the same tenants.

Amara Diallo: API gateway metrics show upstream timeouts to cost-model-service; gateway is returning 504 to Console backend. Retry behavior looks aggressive (3 retries) which might be amplifying.

Sean Gallagher: Mitigation plan:
1) Disable Console breakdown flag for canary tenants (stop calling SCM from Console pages).
2) Scale cost-model-service canary deployment + verify p99 comes down.
3) If still bad, rollback cost-model-service canary build.
Chloe/Benji can you flip flags? Neha scale up now.

Benji Okafor: Flipping `scm_cost_breakdown_enabled=false` for prod canary tenants + staging. ETA 2-3 min to propagate.

Neha Kapoor: Scaling: increasing min replicas from 4 -> 10 in us-east-1 canary pool + bumping CPU limit. Rolling now.

Rafael Mendes: Watching error rate. Timeouts still climbing for the last 2 mins but might be lag.
Also seeing long tail on `/explain` endpoint even though Console is mostly calling `/estimate`.

Chloe Martin: We do call `/explain` for tooltips if breakdown is present. With flag off that should stop.

Dylan Brooks: Confirmed: with the flag disabled, Console will show aggregated “estimated cost” summary only (no breakdown) and should no longer block render.

Jordan Lee: Quick hypothesis: cost-model-service is doing synchronous model-catalog resolution per request because `gpu_sku` missing in some inputs; this forces lookup + retries, and with canary traffic it’s enough to blow p99.
Can we confirm request payloads missing region/SKU?

Chloe Martin: Yep, seeing some requests without `region`/`gpu_sku` from Console path (we rely on backend to infer). When inference fails it calls model-catalog.
Example request body (from debug):
`{ tenant:"ten_9d2", model:"llama3.1-70b", quant_profile_id:"qp_int4_v2", tokens_in:..., tokens_out:..., region:"" }`

Logan Wright: If `region` is blank, cost-model-service tries defaulting; but in the new build I think it now queries catalog by model+tenant+route to guess SKU. That lookup is a couple hundred ms and can fan out.

Sean Gallagher: OK. For immediate mitigation we’ve already cut off Console calls. Next: stop the bleed on SCM itself.
Rafael, do we need to rollback canary build to reduce risk?

Rafael Mendes: After scaling, p95 is improving, p99 still high but trending down. Error rate dropping from ~8% to ~2% over last 5 mins.
If we keep flag off, customer impact is limited to “no breakdown” and should be acceptable short-term.

Neha Kapoor: Replicas are up, CPU back under control. Latency is coming down.

Benji Okafor: Flag propagation complete in prod canary + staging. Console should stop hitting SCM within ~60s.

Dylan Brooks: Seeing Console costs page recover in staging immediately. No more spinners in canary tenant.

Amara Diallo: Gateway 504s dropping now. Also temporarily reducing retries for this upstream from 3 -> 1 for the cost-model route to avoid thundering herd (safe config).

Sean Gallagher: Status update: Incident mitigated via feature flag disable + scaling. Keeping incident open until SCM latency stable.

Jordan Lee: Follow-up needed: Console client must send required inputs (region + gpu_sku if available) or we need cheaper deterministic defaults. Missing signals shouldn’t trigger heavy catalog lookups in hot path.
Also, retries need bounded behavior.

Priya Natarajan: Agreed. We should add a guardrail in cost-model-service: if required fields missing, return fast 4xx with actionable error + assumptions, not attempt expensive inference. Or do lookup asynchronously / cached.

Rafael Mendes: Metrics now: p99 ~1.8s, error rate <0.5%. Still above target but within tolerance for now since Console isn’t calling it.

Sean Gallagher: Marking as RESOLVED with mitigation in place. Keeping Console breakdown disabled for canary until we patch.
Action items:
- [Jordan/Priya] Patch cost-model-service to avoid synchronous catalog lookup on missing `region`/`gpu_sku` (fast-fail + explicit assumptions) + add circuit breaker around catalog dependency.
- [Chloe/Dylan] Console backend: always populate `region` and known `gpu_sku` for hosted/dedicated; reduce client timeout impact (non-blocking render) and implement cached fallback.
- [Amara] Confirm gateway retry policy + timeouts for SCM routes; document standard.
- [Rafael/Sean] Add alert: upstream timeout rate + p99 > SLO for 5m; link runbook; add canary check that simulates Console call pattern.
- [Logan] Verify tag cardinality regression (`model_variant`) in scm request logs; ensure limits.

IncidentBot: INC-3127 status changed to RESOLVED by Sean Gallagher.

Sean Gallagher: Thanks all. Please drop notes here if you find root cause specifics in the canary diff. We’ll do a short retro tomorrow (15m) with Platform + Console.
